meta.name: chain-orchestrator
meta.description: Chain execution manager: validates dependencies, enforces order, tracks violations. Use to verify that all required skill chains were executed and to get the correct execution order.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查每一步是否都已执行并给出正确顺序
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用多个工具顺序处理复杂任务，想避免漏步骤
copy.tagline_en: Check that every step ran in order and get the correct sequence.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle complex tasks with multiple steps and worry about missing one.

howto.what: 该技能负责管理技能链的执行顺序:先运行固定的核心技能链,再按任务类型附加相关技能;并验证各环节依赖是否满足,记录漏跑或顺序错误的技能。
howto.when: 当你说到 chain、orchestrator、validate 等关键词,或要求验证技能链是否都已执行、查询正确的执行顺序时触发。

howto.what_en: Manages skill chain execution: runs a fixed core chain first, then adds task-specific skills based on task type. Validates dependencies and order, logs skipped or mis-ordered steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention chain, orchestrator, validate, or ask to verify required chains were executed or to get the correct execution order.

say_en.text: Verify the current skill chain ran in order
say_en.note: It checks dependencies and order, returns the result
